Claim 1 (Currently Amended): A cleanable, waterborne polyurethane dispersion comprising the reaction product of: A) one or more OH-functional acrylic dispersions and B) one or more polyisocyanates modified with 3-(cyclohexylamino)-propanesulfonic acid (CAPS).

Claim 2 (Currently Amended): The dispersion of claim 1, wherein component A) comprises at least two distinct OH-functional acrylic dispersions.

Claim 3 (Currently Amended): The dispersion of claim 1, wherein component B) comprises at least one polyisocyanate modified with 3-(cyclohexylamino)-propanesulfonic acid (CAPS) based on an aliphatic diisocyanate.

Claim 8 (Currently Amended): The coating of claim 7, wherein the surface roughness, measured in root mean square (RMS) terms, of the coating is greater than 200 nm.
